about: Wild Nine development log: each improvement, why it was made and what the performance analyst should measure. The games lab adds one a month (John, 22 Nov 2026: continuous improvement).

log.what: Two-panel layout on wide screens (course left, controls right) and a wider single column when an unfolded phone is held upright
log.why: On an unfolded iPhone Duo or a tablet the game stayed phone-sized
log.measure: rounds finished per visit on unfolded and tablet screens v phones (screensByVisits)
